description:
The Second Battlegroup

Download (0.98) (File preview is missing, click File -> Download and it should work as normal)

Download

We are the Praetorians of Sol, the final bulwark of Terra.

Born of Sol. Sworn to Terra. Forged by the Domain.

We are the Readied Spear, the Adamantium Lance.

The spear, drawn. The lance, unbroken.

We are the pinnacle of the Domain's might, and the nightmare of her enemies.

First to strike, last to fall, finest ever forged.

We are the Second!

Contents

The Second Battlegroup is an elite line of ships that can be found as derelict outside of the Core Systems (Like XIV Legion). But for gameplay purposes, their blueprint can also be found individually. Their combat doctrine is "Adamantium Lance" which focuses on using overwhelming firepower to break through the enemy lines. They usually emphasize large, frontal weaponry while ignoring point defence, and some ships have slightly modified weapon arcs to perfect their job.

Their Battlegroup bonus is quite similar to the XIV, but the bonus and penalty are all increased. Overall, they are stronger than XIV ships. Due to the change in weapon systems, they usually cost 20-25% more DP compared to their vanilla counterparts and cost 3x as much (XIV ships cost 1.75x). Auxiliary ships have lower bonuses and less radical restructuring, so they only cost 1.5x as much.

Main Ships

Spoiler
Brawler (II)

Mobile artillery ship with Advance targeting core

Hammerhead (II)

Just a hammerhead with spinal large hardpoint

Sunder (II)

Also known as the Trident or Sunder MK3
MK3, 3? Get it? It has 3 large hardpoints!

Eagle (II)

Just a Eagle with spinal large hardpoint..Also comes with Plasma Jet

Heron (II)

One LPC slot less, one large missile hardpoint more...come with another 4 small ones for free.

Apogee (II)

Sensors, data centers, electronic warfare, all nicely packaged in a box. Did I mention it also has 3 large hardpoints?

Champion (II)

...Where is my XL spinal weapon???

Conquest (II)

SEVEN ****ING LARGE WEAPONS! FOUR ****ING COMPOSITES!

Invictus (II)

What if we fuse 4 large slots into an XXL weapon?
yes I know the weapon is missing let's keep that as a surprise

Auxiliary Ships

Spoiler
Kite (II) (A)

It's only a medium turret because our engineers aren't pirates and are paid a living wage.

Shepherd (II) (A)

A proper combat support ship. Logistics? Leave that to the dedicated large ships.

Condor (II) (A)

What if we really added a large hardpoint to Condor?

Venture (II) (A)

Temu Gryphon? No no no, I AM THE UPGRADE

Atlas (II) (A)

This beats a hound in Sim

Fighters

Spoiler
Trident (II)

What if we put ECCM on fighters?

Broadsword (II)

Yes its another Broadsword with dual MG instead

Warthog (II)

No this is not an A-10
Yes that is an Assault Chaingun
Yes it overfluxes in less than one second
No I'm not giving it extra flux

Weapons

Spoiler
Locust SRM Launcher (II)

Haha EMP Arcs go brrrrt

Mjolnir Cannon (II)

What if we make it bigger? And more unstable?
Hellbore on suicide watch right now

Gauss Cannon (II)

1000 range is enough for me thank you very much!

Assault Chaingun (II)

FASTER! STRONGER! BETTER!
Also eats more flux

Dual Flak Cannon (II)

What if we make it even faster?

Graviton Beam (II)

POV: You tried to combine Ion Bean with Graviton Beam

Ion Beam (II)

POV: You tried to combine Graviton Beam with Ion Bean

LR PD Laser (II)

Hybrid

Change Logs

Spoiler
v2.1.0: Updated for Starsector 0.98.5a-RC4. Balance Change: (2026/11/11)
Spoiler
Conquest (II) Top Speed: 45 -> 55; Acceleration: 20 -> 25; Deceleration: 15 -> 20
Hammerhead (II) Flux Capacity: 4200 -> 5000
Champion (II) Ordnance Points: 175 -> 200; Flux Dissipation: 550 -> 650
Apogee (II) Max Burn: 8 -> 9; Deployment and Monthly Supply Costs: 25 -> 23
Brawler (II) Added the DO_NOT_TURN_TO_ARMOR AI hint
Invictus (II) Crew Salary Multiplier: 1.5x
Atlas (II) (A) Crew Salary Multiplier: 0.5x
Kite (II) (A) Crew Salary Multiplier: 0.5x
LR PD Laser (II) Range: 1000 -> 1200; Beam Speed: 3600 -> 6000

v2.0.2: Attempt to fix self hitting bug (2026/4/7)
v2.0.1: SAVE GAME COMPATIBLE!!! You just won't get the new weapons in loot. You can find them in Prism Freeport. (2026/2/8)
Second Battlegroup ships and weapons can be found in Prisma Freeport.
Added the following Second Battlegroup weapons:
Locust SRM Launcher (II); Gauss Cannon (II); Assault Chaingun (II); LR PD Laser (II); Mjolnir Cannon (II); Graviton Beam (II); Ion Beam (II); Dual Flak Cannon (II)
v1.5.0: Added Apogee (II) and revised Condor's sprites. Also added some more flavor texts. (2025/10/1)
v1.4.0: Added Sunder (II) and revised multiple ship sprites (Invictus, Conquest, Champion, Eagle, Hammerhead) to be more consistent (2025/9/28).
v1.3.2: Added Support for version checker (2025/9/2)
v1.3.1: Fixed some minor coding. Balance Change: (2025/7/30)
Spoiler
Invictus (II) Ordinance Points: 200 -> 225
Champion (II) Built-in hullmod: Ballistic Rangefinder -> Energy Bolt Coherer

v1.3.0: Fixed some minor coding issues and added Venture (II) (A) (2025/6/18)
v1.2.1: Fixed the bug where Brawler have a comically small collision radius (2025/6/15)
v1.2.0: Added Kite (II) (A) and Shepherd (II) (A). Also changed the color of Second Battlegroup Auxilia design (2025/5/21)
v1.1.0: Added Champion (II) (2025/5/19)
v1.0.2: Added II ships to title screen and sim battle (2025/5/18)
v1.0.1: Fixed the bugs that the Lance of Oblivion will turn and Player fleet won't spawn these ship even if it has the blueprint (2025/5/17)
v1.0.0: Release (2025/5/16)
